Hi Tessa / Karthik,

Thanks again for the call earlier. Contoso is ready to publish our managed deployment offer (Contoso AI Assist) to Azure Marketplace. We finished the initial payload and have two asks before we move to technical validation:

- A quick sanity check on the payload we attached (contoso_offer_payload_v1.json). We need a short turnaround (by 2026-09-22) so the Contoso GTM team can coordinate co-sell readiness.

I've attached the payload and our co-sell playbook draft. Let me know if you want to hop on a 20-min screen share.

Thanks,

Cheers,

Subject: Re: New offer: ready for authorship & who will own portal?

Adding some technical notes after a quick look at contoso_offer_payload_v1.json:

- Identity: their ARM template references a managed identity flow; we need the exact service principal (appId + tenant) that will be used for onboarding. Contoso should provide the SPN and an access test result (curl to /health with az login token) so we can map endpoints during validation.
- SKU mapping: their SKU names are camelCase (Contoso.Pro, Contoso.Enterprise). Azure prefers hyphenated, lowercase SKUs; not a blocker but worth normalizing.
- Private link: they listed a privatelink scope but didn't include the vnet/subnet IDs. If this is a private offer we need more network evidence.

I'll be available tomorrow morning to run through the payload with them. Tessa — if you mark yourself as owner in Publisher Center, I'll prepare the validation checklist and the sample smoke tests.

-Karthik
Senior Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference

Sara
